report.title: Something’s not right
report.lead: Tell us what you saw. We’ll check it and fix it.

placeholder.CONTENT: For example: that isn’t the right answer, or there’s a typo.
placeholder.BUG: For example: I tap the button and nothing happens.
placeholder.MARKET: For example: the price doesn’t match the real one.

report.context: We send the screen you’re on (and the lesson, question or asset) along with your report so we can find it faster.

reports.title: Bug reports
reports.what: What users send with “Something’s not right”: wrong content, app bugs or market data.
reports.question: Question

gift.title: Plan and gifts
gift.stripeNote: Pays with Stripe: a gift doesn’t change the plan they pay for. It pushes back their next charge by the days you give.
gift.teamNote: Team member: already uses the app with everything unlocked.
gift.confirm: Gift {what} to {email}? They’ll get a notification.
gift.confirmStripe: {email} pays with Stripe: the gift will push back their next charge by {n} days ({what} free). Continue?
gift.reason: Reason (optional, only the team sees it)
gift.confirmRevoke: Remove the running gift from {email}? They go back to Free right now.

user.viewOnly: You’re viewing the app as another user: controls are off. Leave “view as” to use them.
user.title: Controls
user.confirmStreak: Set {email}’s streak to {n} days? It will count as if they used the app yesterday.
user.confirmWelcome: Send the welcome notification to {email} again?
user.confirmUnblock: Unblock {email}? They’ll be able to sign in again.
user.confirmBlock: Block {email}? Their sessions will be closed and they won’t be able to sign in.
user.blockNote: This doesn’t cancel their Stripe subscription: if they pay, handle it in Stripe too.

glance.title: At a glance
glance.blocked: {n, plural, one {# blocked account} other {# blocked accounts}}

grant.title: Give out
grant.lead: Virtual money, XP, gems, lives, freezes or streak. Logged in the audit.

limit.CASH: Up to €1,000,000 at once. Taking: at most their cash.
limit.STREAK: From 0 to 3,650 days. Counts as if they used the app yesterday.

grant.cashNote: Simulation money, not real. It doesn’t count as return in the league.
grant.league: Also count it in this week’s league
grant.leagueOn: Careful: it will count in this week’s league and move them up past people who earned it playing.
grant.leagueOff: Doesn’t count in the league: only their XP and level go up.
grant.streakNote: Missed days show as protected in their calendar.
grant.reason: Reason (optional, only the team sees it)
grant.notify: Let them know with a team message
grant.notifyPlaceholder: Your own text (optional). Use '{name}' for their name.
grant.notifyHint: If you leave it empty, they get a message in their language like: “{example}”
grant.noLinks: No links or HTML: plain text only.

notice.CASH: The E-Trading team has given you {n} in virtual money for your portfolio.
notice.CASH_NEG: We’ve adjusted your virtual portfolio: {n} less in cash.
notice.XP: The E-Trading team has given you {n} XP.
notice.GEMS: The E-Trading team has given you {n} gems.
notice.LIVES: We’ve refilled your lives so you can keep learning.

confirm.CASH_NEG: Take {n} in virtual money from {email}’s cash?

grant.confirmLeague: It will count in this week’s league.
grant.doneNotified: Done. We’ve sent them the message.

compose.replace: Replace what you’ve written with the template?
compose.tplNote: Templates come out in {lang}. You can edit them before sending.
compose.title: Title (optional)
compose.noLinks: No links: remove them to send.

user.title: Team message
user.lead: It pops up as a window next time they open the app and stays in their Notifications. {devices, plural, =0 {No phone notifications.} one {Phone notifications on: they also get one (at a sensible hour).} other {Notifications on # devices: they also get one (at a sensible hour).}}
user.blocked: The account is blocked: they won’t see messages.

messages.title: Team messages
messages.what: Write to several people at once. It pops up as a window when they open the app, stays in their Notifications and, if they have phone notifications, they get one (never 22:00–9:00 and no more than 6 a day). To write to one person, open them in Users.
messages.viewOnly: You’re viewing the app as another user: nothing can be sent.
messages.count: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody matches these filters} one {# person} other {# people}}
messages.countHint: {push} with phone notifications. Excludes the team and blocked accounts.
messages.send: {n, plural, one {Send to # person} other {Send to # people}}
messages.confirm1: You’re about to send this message to {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} ({who}). Continue?
messages.confirm2: Final check: {n, plural, one {# person will get it} other {# people will get it}} and it can’t be undone. Send now?
messages.sent: {n, plural, one {Sent to # person} other {Sent to # people}}
messages.limits: Limits: one group message every 2 minutes and 5 a day at most.
